name: workbench
description: Five explicit Workbench skills for repository, memory, Jira, Figma, and official-evidence shaping, guarded project memory updates, worktree execution, and integrated validation.

interface.shortDescription: Shape and execute sourced work in isolated worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides five independently invoked skills: shape a change from repository, Local Work Memory, linked Jira and Figma artifacts, and official evidence; apply its guarded Memory Change Set; prepare an exact task and worktree topology; execute one implementation or integration task; and finalize the clean integrated result with failure testing and independent review.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to create a sourced Shape Report for this change.
Use $workbench:prepare to turn this Shape Report into worktree task packets.
Use $workbench:execute-task to execute this prepared task in its assigned worktree.
